request.style: English, warm classic soul, rich female lead vocal with backing singers, Rhodes electric piano, horn section, round bass, tight drums, tambourine, smooth and uplifting, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
It was about noon at Jacob's well, the sun was beating down
I came to draw my water when nobody was around
A tired Jewish stranger sitting quiet by the stone
Said give me a drink, and I said why ask me, you should leave me alone

[Verse]
If you knew the gift of God and who it is who speaks to you
You would have asked him for a drink, and he'd have given you
Living water, and I said sir, the well is deep and wide
You have nothing to draw with, where's the water you supply

[Chorus]
Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again
But whoever drinks the water I give will never thirst again
The water I give will become in them
A spring of water welling up to eternal life
Sir, give me this water

[Verse]
He told me everything I ever did, and still he did not go
He said the hour is coming when the true worshipers will know
God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth
I said Messiah is coming, and he said I am he

[Chorus]
Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again
But whoever drinks the water I give will never thirst again
The water I give will become in them
A spring of water welling up to eternal life
Sir, give me this water

[Bridge]
I left my water jar and ran back to the town
Come and see a man who told me everything I ever did
Could this be the Christ
This man really is the Savior of the world

[Outro]
Never thirst again
Living water
